_help: Who says what, and when. Edit lines freely. {hint}, {stars}, {title}, {name} are filled in by the game. {name} cannot be recorded, so a line with it always uses text-to-speech. 'question' has no lines: the speaker reads the question itself. Speaker "trainer" means the trainer the player picked; a character id (e.g. "tuki") always uses that character.
